༄༅/ /'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zung gi sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zung gi sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa mdor bsdus zhig 'chang bar 'dod pas 'di la gnyis yod pa'i gnyis ka sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs 'dra bar snang yang bskyed tshul mi 'dra zhing*/ gzhal yas khang yod med dang sems dpa' sum brtsegs yod med kyang mi 'dra ba'i phyir gzhan la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pas gnyis ka 'god par bya ste/ de las dang po ni/ bris sku dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams grub na sta gon byas nas/ /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang mchod/ mchod pa/ sngon 'gro gtor ma rnams bcu gsum ma ltar byin gyi brlabs/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom tshul/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren rnams bcu gsum ma ltar la/ tshogs zhing mchod pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying ka'i hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa'-i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar spyi ltar mchod cing*/ rjes mdzad pa'i/ rab 'byams zhing na dbang po'i nye bar 'tsho/ /zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa de'am/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /zhes sogs bdun rnam dag bya/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang*/ tshad med bzhi yang bcu gsum ma ltar bya/ rgyun pa'i tshe tshogs zhing nas tshad med tsam/ byas kyang rung*/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya ta nas at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gzhan gyi chos thams cad brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa rwa shin tu gdengs pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang la bkod/

tshur 'dus nas rdo rje la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa/ ha ha zhes sgrog cing ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad cing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ zhal nas hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ mi'i khrag dang zhag dang rkang dang tshil bu za ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod pa bskam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang mi rus kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa che ba/ gcer bu'i gzugs can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan cing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tāṃḥ sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba nas shriḥye āḥhūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ chu lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/

rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar sngar bzhin mchod cing*/ nang mchod ni/ bsdu na/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ya mān+ta ka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ bsdu na/ gzugs mchog ma dang*/ rgyas par na rjes mdzad pa'i/ na maḥshrī badz+ra bhai ra wa ya/ thal chen mdog can ma he'i steng na/ ma he'i gdong can gshin rje'i gshed ni/ /'jigs rung zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs shing*/ /rngams pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog la phyag 'tshal/ /mig sman lta bur gnag pa'i sku ni/ /rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer dang ldan/ /dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum bgrad nas/ /bdud dpung phyai mar 'thag la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas g.yon phyag gis 'bar ba'i gri gug / bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin cing*/ brkyangs bskums zhabs kyi gar stabs brjid pas/ /log 'dren zil gyis gnon pa phyag 'tshal/ /gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing*/ ral pa ser skya gyen du rab 'bar/ /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i ljags ni bskyod pas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ / thod bskam lnga yis dbu la legs brgyan/ /brgya phyed thod phreng do shal 'phyang zhing*/ /nyin byed 'bum phrag bsdoms pa'i mdangs ldan/ /ye shes med dpung 'phro la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ /rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan gyi dbus su hūṃ yig dang mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer nag po drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can 'phro zhing*/ phreng ba hūṃ las mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la sngags gsum bzla zhing yig brgya brjod/ gtor ma yod tshe nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas sngar bzhin bskyed cing ye shes pa dgug gzhug sogs byed pa'am/

bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ hrīḥṣ+tā+-i'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wā ya a dhi pa ta ye i daṃ ba ling ta pra tīts+tsha ya swāhā/ zhes pa bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/ sngar ltar phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gnyis gang rung bya/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma 'dod na 'dul zhing*/ chos rgyal gtor 'bul byas na legs par rje nyid bzhed/ mthar yig brgya brjod de/ ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dam tshig pa bskyed na/ ye shes pa gshegs shing rang nyid la thim par bsam mo/ /'di la gzhal yas khang bsgoms kyang mi 'gal bar sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ paṇa chen rin po ches bshad pa bzhin bkod na/ rgyas par ni sngar bshad pa ltar tshad med bzhi sgom pa'i bar byas na'ang legs shing*/ bsdu na/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du ma he sngon po mgo g.yas phyogs su bstan nas nyal ba/ de'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong ba can/ rwa rnon po gnyis dang ldan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes shing mi mgo bskam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu byas te 'dzin pa/ gcer bu mi rus kyi 'khor lo dang rna cha la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ bdud dpung thams cad rtsad nas 'byin pa'i stobs dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ de'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos kyi rgyal bo btsong kha pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgyas shes rab kyi ral gri dang brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la 'jam dpal ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i gshin rje gshed spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs nas gong ltar nang mchod dang bcas pa 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃḥ'ajigs rung gzugs can ma he khros pa'i zhal/ /rngams pa'i nga ros sa gsum g.yo bar byed/ /thugs rje nus pas 'gro drug dbyings su 'dren/ /sku gsum mngon gyur gshen rje gshed la 'dud/

/zhes dang*/ gzugs mchog mas bstod kyang chog /rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar nyi gdan la hūṃ sngon po dhīḥs mtshan pa/ de'i mthar a ra pa tsa na dang*/ ya mān+ta ka'i sngags kyis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing*/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ gtor ma 'bul na mdun du sngar ltar bskyed de ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sogs byed pa'am/ bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i gshin rje gshed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ hūṃ/ 'jigs rung gzugs can zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ /bcom ldan 'jigs byed chen po yis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes 'phrin las bcol/ chos rgyal gyi gtor ma yod na/ skad cig gis spyan drangs nas 'bul/ gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya bzlas nas/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa yin na/ ye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces bya/ nyer bsdu byed na/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rang la thim/ rang ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de rim gyis stong pa'i 'od gsal du thim pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gshin rje gshed po 'grub 'gyur nas/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngo smon bya'o/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /drag po'i skur bstan gshin rje'i gshed/ /zung gi sgrub thabs spel ba'i dges/ /skye kun 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di yang shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis 'di gnyis kyi 'phrin las spel phyir dad pas dam pa'i man ngag ltar co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o// //maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ 'jigs byed kyi 'pho ba bsdus pa bzhugs/ na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ 'jigs byed la brten pa'i 'pho ba paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad 'dug kyang cung zad kha bskang dgos par snang bas/ 'dir kha bskang ba'i sgo nas 'khyer bder dgod par bya ste/ rang nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed du/ /gsal ba'i lus dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma/ /mda' snyug tsam zhig mar sna lte 'og dang*/ /yar sna tshangs bug khar zung snying kha'i dbus/ /rang sems hūṃ sngon 'phar zhing 'phur la khad/ /spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ /gri thod 'dzin pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus ky-i/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros rang 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ /bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung bshags/ /dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bsngo/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob tu gsol/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes pa sbyong ba'i dus su lan nyer gcig re brjod pa'i mthar/ bla ma 'jigs byed chen po'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu glog 'khyug bzhin/ /spyi bor dbu ma'i nang zhugs rang gi sems/ /hūṃ yig rnam pa can la zug par gyur/

/de nas hig ces lan re brjod pa dang rnam shes hūṃ gi rnam pa can de yar 'phangs te tshangs bug la reg tsam dang*/ hig ces brjod pa dang slar snying khar 'bab cing de lta bu lan nyer gcig bya/ de bzhin du slar gsol 'debs dang rnam shes 'phen 'bebs grangs ci nus byas pas rtags 'byung*/ mthar spyi bo'i 'jigs byed kyang snying kha'i hūṃ la thim nas rang sems dang bla ma lhag pa'i lha gsum dbyer med du bsams la bsngo smon bya/ 'chi ba'i dus su/ rnam shes lha'i thugs kar thim nas mkha' spyod dang bde ba can gang mos su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing yang yang bsam/ 'di gzhan la 'debs na rang zhes pa gzhan du bsgyur bar bya ste/ bde ba can du skye bar 'dod na dag pa mkha' spyod ces pa/ zhing mchog bde ba can du 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes bsgyur chog cing gsol 'debs gzhan byed na/ gnad gcod gshin rje'i 'jigs las skyob tu gsol/ /bar do'i 'khrul snang ma lus bsal du gsol/ /skyabs mgon mdzod cig bla ma yi dam lha/ re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes zungs/ /zhes byas kyang legs so/ /ces 'jigs byed kyi 'pho ba mdor bsdus pa 'di yang shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis re gnyis la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo// //maṅgalaṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'buma'ajigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zung gi sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas bzhugs/ - PAGE 348-- PAGE 347-- PAGE 339-
